# Quaternius source assets

Unmodified source `.blend` files used for the Crownfall art study. Author: **Quaternius**. License: **CC0-1.0**. Retrieved 2026-11-17 from the creator's itch.io downloads.

| Source | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Animated Dinosaur Pack, December 2018 | [Creator pack page](https://quaternius.com/packs/animateddinosaurs.html), [download page](https://quaternius.itch.io/animated-lowpoly-dinosaurs), bundled `License.txt` |
| Animated Knight Pack, July 2018 | [Creator pack page](https://quaternius.com/packs/knightcharacter.html), [download page](https://quaternius.itch.io/lowpoly-animated-knight) |

Both creator pack pages label these releases CC0 and permit personal/commercial projects. The knight itch.io listing independently links CC0; its downloaded ZIP has no separate license file. `License.txt` here is the verbatim file from the dinosaur ZIP. `sources.json` records each retained source's hash, archive member and public source page. These findings apply to these specific older packs, not every present or future Quaternius product.

The CC0 legal text is at <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode>. Credit is not required by CC0, but the project should retain this provenance record. Suggested courtesy credit: “Base knight and dinosaur meshes and animations by Quaternius (CC0); adapted for Crownfall.” No endorsement is implied.

Generated adaptations live in `../../roster/`. New geometry, palette and scripts are project-authored work; this notice does not select a repository-wide code or asset license.
